tools.name: create_video
tools.description: Start a motion video from a public product URL or a prompt. Returns at once with status "queued"; poll get_video until it is "ready", then give the user video_url (needs the API key) or call share_video for a public link; poster_url is its cover image. Counts as one video per 30 seconds.

tools.name: get_video
tools.description: Status and links for one video. status is queued, running, ready or failed; revising is true while a revise runs.

tools.name: revise_video
tools.description: Change a ready video with a note, e.g. "make the headline shorter" or "use a darker background in the last scene". The earlier cut is kept as a version. The first three changes to a video are included, then each counts as one video; poll get_video until revising is false.

tools.name: share_video
tools.description: Turn a public share link on (default) or off for a ready video. Anyone with share_url can watch without an account.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: The account's plan and how many videos it has left (credits.available).

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "create_video" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

Returns at once with status "queued"; poll get_video until it is "ready", then give the user video_url (needs the API key) or call share_video for a public link; poster_url is its cover image. Spends credits." → after: "Start a motion video from a public product URL or a prompt. Returns at once with status "queued"; poll get_video until it is "ready", then give the user video_url (needs the API key) or call share_video for a public link; poster_url is its cover image. findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
